title: Wear a Giant Chicken
tagline: For that one weird cousin at the family reunion, this $1,199 Lababu costume is oddly perfect. Imagine the look when they show up as a giant, fluffy bird.

title: Supercar for the Utterly Lost
tagline: Because getting lost in the woods deserves 1,360 horsepower, the Koenigsegg RAW is perfect for when your GPS fails and your ego doesn't.

title: Chess, But You’re the Pawn
tagline: For when your neighbor’s ‘backyard game night’ involves a magnifying glass and a suspicious lack of clothing. This oversized chess set turns your lawn into a battlefield where the only rule is ‘don’t step on the rook.’ Perfect for those who’ve always wanted to yell ‘checkmate’ while standing on a giant plastic knight. Just don’t blame us if your dog starts playing too.

title: Stairway to Slide Heaven
tagline: For the overgrown kid who refuses to grow up. This slide staircase is perfect for your loft apartment where you’ve replaced furniture with foam pits. Now you can glide from your ‘home office’ (aka your fort) to the kitchen for midnight snacks without the hassle of stairs. Just don’t blame us when your cat starts judging your life choices.

title: Jetpack for Your Board
tagline: Ever wanted to feel like a dolphin on dry land? This hoverboard is your ticket to becoming the office's most obnoxious commuter. Perfect for those who've mastered the art of looking busy while actually just floating around the break room. Just don't blame us when HR asks why you're doing laps around the printer.

title: Ski-Doo for Your Living Room
tagline: Forget shoveling—just mount this indoor snowmobile to your couch and let the neighbors wonder why you're revving engines at 3 AM. Perfect for those who want to feel like they're in a snowstorm while binge-watching 'The Great British Bake Off.' Comes with a free 'I Survived the Blizzard of 2023' sticker.

title: Ballistic Bowling Chaos
tagline: Because your backyard needed a cannon that launches bowling balls, ideally during a heated argument with your neighbor over lawn care.

title: Bubble Trouble for Bad Vibes
tagline: For when your existential dread needs a physical form to dissolve in. Perfect for the overthinker who’s convinced their bathtub is a portal to another dimension—just add this, and suddenly, the void is just a fizzy memory. Bonus: your cat will now think you’re a witch.

title: Shark Attack Survival Kit
tagline: For when your camping trip takes a turn into Jaws territory. This knife isn't just for cutting rope—it's your ticket out of a great white's lunch menu. Perfect for the over-prepared outdoorsman who also packs a life raft for a hike.

title: Island for the Eccentric
tagline: Because who needs friends when you can own a private island? Spend $13 million on Columbia Island and enjoy solo sunsets, awkward seagull conversations, and the occasional lost sailor showing up for dinner.

title: DeLorean Gone Wild
tagline: For the eccentric uncle who insists on reenacting Marty McFly's adventures in the woods, this off-road DeLorean is a necessity, because what's a family reunion without a time-traveling ATV?

title: Bubbles of Questionable Taste
tagline: For the eccentric aunt who insists on hosting dinner parties in a sci-fi film set, Pierre Cardin's Bubble Palace is the ultimate conversation starter – or relationship ender.

title: Robo Vest of Awkwardness
tagline: For when you need to crush a beer festival while also needing help standing up, this bionic exoskeleton vest is your awkward savior.

title: Toot Trap Blanket
tagline: For when you want to marinate in your own aroma during a camping trip with friends, this kit has got you covered – literally.

title: Babel Buds: Speak Like a Local (Sort Of)
tagline: For when your Tinder date speaks only Klingon and you refuse to learn it. These earbuds won't make you fluent, but they'll at least let you order a beer in 40 languages without pointing at the menu like a caveman. Perfect for awkward family dinners with your in-laws from Quebec or arguing with a taxi driver in Tokyo.

title: Shark Jet Pack Madness
tagline: Because your snorkeling trip wasn't weird enough, strap on this shark jet pack and zoom past startled fish, confusing your dive buddies and possibly a few marine biologists.
